maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is insurance premiums on earthquake, casualty, inland marine, crop and surety policies, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Premiums are paid by private homeowners and businesses; crop line has some federal program links but is a minor part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth is mainly organic underwriting of specialty lines; Gray Surety was an occasional acquisition, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Property and casualty policies are renewed annually and customers can move to other carriers or brokers fairly easily.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call, since coverage can be required by lenders or regulation, but policies can be replaced at renewal.
